name: Wither Palm
description: Strike with an open palm that carries a pale chill so the struck limb goes weak and slow to answer.

name: Ashen Guard
description: Wrap both forearms in grey ash qi that dulls a blow and leaves the striker's hand numb.

name: Fading Step
description: Slip aside on a soft heel so the foe loses sight of the body for one heartbeat.

name: Sap Knuckle
description: Drive one knuckle into the muscle and draw a little strength out of the limb that was hit.

name: Limp Grasp
description: Clasp the foe's wrist and let death qi seep through until the fingers loosen their hold.

name: Dim Turn
description: Turn a thrust aside with the back of the wrist while a grey haze takes the heart out of the push.

name: Rot Touch
description: Lay two fingers on cloth or leather or wood and set a quick rot spreading through it.

name: Decay Press
description: Press a flat hand to the body and let decay qi sink in until the muscle under it sags.

name: Spoil Guard
description: Meet a wooden weapon with a rotting forearm so the shaft softens and splinters on contact.

name: Slow Wilt
description: Hold a hand near the foe's chest and let a slow wilt dim the strength of each breath.

name: Rotcreep Step
description: Creep forward in low slow steps that blur at the edge of sight and close the gap unseen.

name: Blight Flick
description: Flick a pinch of blighted qi at the face from two paces so it stings and clouds the eyes.

name: Waning Block
description: Catch a swing on the forearm and let the force wane out of it as it slides away.

name: Cinder Brace
description: Pack ash qi along the shoulder and take a shove on it so the force dies in the grey.

name: Dust Veil
description: Throw a quick sleeve of dust qi across the front to turn a stab off its line.

name: Ash Palm
description: Strike with a palm coated in fine ash that numbs the skin where it lands.

name: Grey Pivot
description: Pivot on the ball of the foot behind a puff of ash and leave a standing blur.

name: Soot Smear
description: Smear soot qi across the foe's weapon hand so the grip slips for a moment.

name: Lapse Step
description: Lower the heel without sound and carry the weight over it so no ground cracks underfoot.

name: Still Drift
description: Drift sideways on slack knees with the breath held so the body seems to stand still.

name: Lull Palm
description: Strike low under the ribs with a soft palm that drains the wind from the lungs.

name: Ebb Turn
description: Turn away on a falling breath so the foe's strike meets only empty air.

name: Muted Block
description: Take a blow on crossed wrists with the body gone slack so the force sinks and fades.

name: Numb Jab
description: Jab two fingers at the nerve bundle of the elbow and leave the arm tingling and dull.

name: Pale Hold
description: Close a hand about the ankle and let a pale cold hold the leg stiff.

name: Ebb Reading
description: Read the rise and fall of a near chest to judge how tired or hurt a person is.

name: Sapping Touch
description: Touch the bare wrist and pull a thin thread of warmth and strength into your own palm.

name: Siphon Grasp
description: Grasp the forearm and pull stamina slowly out so the foe's swings lose their snap.

name: Wane Brace
description: Brace a forearm that drinks a little force from each blow and lets it go cold.

name: Parch Strike
description: Strike the shoulder and wring the moisture of effort from the arm so it hangs heavy.

name: Thin Step
description: Narrow the stance to a thin line and slide past a swing with the body turned edge on.

name: Gaunt Press
description: Press the thumb to the base of the throat so the foe's breath stutters and the guard drops.

name: Stifle Palm
description: Strike the breastbone with a flat palm so the foe's breath snags and shortens.

name: Clouded Gaze
description: Hold the foe's eyes and let death qi cloud them so every edge blurs.

name: Shutting Hand
description: Close a hand on the foe's sleeve and let a dead weight drag at the arm.

name: Slack Block
description: Meet a punch with a loose wrist that lets the force drain down the arm and out.

name: Emptied Step
description: Step into the space a swing has just left empty and keep the feet quiet.

name: Wane Jab
description: Jab at the ribs with a stiff finger so the foe's next breath comes short.

name: Rasp Reading
description: Listen to the rasp of a nearby person's breathing to learn which lung is tired or hurt.

name: Thin Pall
description: Spread a thin pall of weakening qi round the body so near foes tire a little faster.

name: Shroud Guard
description: Draw the pall in close about the arms and let it swallow the sound and weight of a blow.

name: Pale Strike
description: Strike with a fist wrapped in pallor so the bruise goes grey and cold at once.

name: Stilled Step
description: Stop mid-stride with perfect stillness so a charging foe overshoots the user.

name: Sigh Hold
description: Breathe out a long cold sigh over the foe's hands and leave the fingers heavy and slow.

name: Cooling Palm
description: Strike with a palm that pulls the heat from the flesh and leaves a dull numb patch.

name: Ebbing Grasp
description: Close a hand on the shoulder and let the warmth of effort ebb out through the palm.

name: Numbing Guard
description: Hold up a forearm that numbs the striker's knuckles and turns the blow aside.

name: Dulling Touch
description: Tap the inside of the foe's elbow so the limb loses feeling and the guard sags.

name: Pallid Step
description: Step in with a drained pale body that gives the foe no breath of heat to track.

name: Stilling Fist
description: Drive a still fist to the sternum so the foe's chest locks for a moment.
